transcript.text: There are two leading causes of failure
when it comes to trading. The first is
that traders don't have a strategy and I
saw this a lot during the COVID pandemic
where we had this incredible bull
market. But one of the things I noticed
is that a lot of people came in during
the pandemic and they were getting
lucky. They were just buying a stock and
it would go higher and they would make
money and and it felt like a lot of
people benefited from beginner's luck.
They were just at the right place at the
right time. But that luck runs out. So
the first group of traders that fail
fail because they don't have a strategy.
They don't really have a repeatable
process of stock selection, of where to
buy, of exit indicators. It's not
systemized. The second group of traders
lose not because they don't have a
strategy. They lack the discipline to
follow the rules of the strategy.
